text:
people-ops: Drafting a tiny 'Manager Handshake' card for goals that touch hiring/benefits/ops. Aim: one scannable block managers can paste into calibration notes + a separate wiring lane for hiring/HR so nothing stalls. PTAL @leah @marc

people-ops: Template (copy/paste into 1:1, calibration notes, or ticket):

people-ops: ```
Outcome: Hire and onboard Senior Infra Eng to reduce model P95 by 20% across prod jobs.
Headcount ask: 1 SWE-Sr (IC) | Req date: 2024-09-01
Impact metric: P95 gen latency down 20% (current P95 420ms)
Hiring ops: need job code + recruiter assigned; ping: hiring-ops
Comp/Benefits: Budget approved at mid-Sr level; confirm relocation/eq via HR@people-ops
Timeline: Interview loop complete by 2024-08-15; offer by 2024-08-22
Privacy: internal managers + hiring-ops only unless candidate opts in
Reviewer note: [ ] Evidence ok [ ] Role justified [ ] Ops wired
```

leah: This is great. Two thoughts: 1) add a short 'hand-off ticket' line with intended Jira/Asana owner so hiring-ops can triage; 2) include `ops:` tags like `ops: hiring|hr|infra` so tools can filter.

marc: Suggest a compressed Slack paste variant for skip-levels and quick syncs: `Hire Sr Infra | 1 headcount | P95 -20% | need recruiter + jobcode (hiring-ops) | req by 2024-09-01` — fits one line.

jason: For benefits-heavy asks (e.g., phased return + parental top-up), maybe include a `benefit-flag` so people-ops can pre-warm payroll. e.g., `benefit-flag: phased-pay`

hiring-ops: tiny note: please include expected leveling band and remote/on-site preference so we can estimate interview loop length. We can auto-add recruiter once `jobcode` is set.

people-ops: Thanks, all. We'll: 1) add `hand-off ticket` field; 2) add `ops:` tag list; 3) include compressed Slack one-liner; 4) add optional `benefit-flag` label. We'll also add a short example for "ramp + headcount swap" where a ramping employee releases 0.5FTE and we hire 0.5FTE backfill.

marc: Could we add a tiny guidance line for managers about public visibility? e.g., `If this involves benefits or sensitive pay details, mark privacy: HR-only and do not paste into public channels.`

people-ops: Good call — will add explicit visibility guidance and a suggested subject line for ticketing: `GH: hire-sr-infra / handoff` so manager-tooling can pick it up.

manager-tooling: We'll add a `copy-to-ticket` button on the doc that pre-fills Jira fields: summary, role, req date, ops tags. Will PR once doc is live.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Handbook snippet "Manager Handshake Cards" scheduled to publish 2024-08-07. Announcement will post to #announcements. :bell:

leah: I'll pilot the card in my next calibration; will share two live examples (one hiring + one benefits ramp case).

people-ops: Thanks team! We'll update the live draft by EOD with the new fields and the one-line paste variants, then ping for a final quick review. :white_check_mark:
